info.name: DAturUpanandinIwippaRI
info.value: ' graTnAtIti tu sandarBe granTayet granTatIti yO . kOwilye granTate granTe: grATayet graTati graTe: ' (Slo. 97) - devaH .

examples: 'vi SuzRasya saNgraTitamanarvA vidat' (f॰10.61.13). saNgraTitam=sannadDam. sandfbDam. sambadDam.
'tena saNgraTitAH sumanasa AbaDnAmi yaSo mayi' (pA॰gf॰2.7). saNgraTitAH=gumPitAH.
'tadyaTA punarAgranTaM punarnigranTamantaM baDnIyAnmayUKaM vAntato DAraRAya nihanyAt tAdfk tat' (E0 brA0 5.15).
'tadyaTA punarAgranTaM punarnirgranTamantaM baDnIyAt mayUKaM vA'ntato DAraRAya nihanyAt tAdfk tat' (E0 brA0 5.15). asyApyarTanirdeSAyeha punaranuvAdaH. AgranTamAgraTyAgraTya.
'tadyaTA punarAgranTaM punirnigranTaM baDnIyAnmayUKaM vA'ntato DAraRAya nihanyAt tAdfk tat' (E0 brA0 5.15).
'karmASayaM graTitamudgraTayanti santaH' (BA0 pu0 4.22.39). udgraTayanti granTiBedanaM kurvanti. graTa iti kavikalpito DAtuH.
